c11.recommendation: H1: keep 3.0 K, correct the density (61.6 kg/m3 at 3.0 K, not the 3.19 K value 58.61) and raise the He-3 ullage to 8 % so the liquid may warm +0.3 K: the denser liquid pays for the extra ullage, the farm length is set by the D2/H2 classes, and no cooler input is added. H3 (2.0 K) gives more allowance but adds ~290 kW of cooler input and LOW rejection, which the joint point cannot afford. Bulk hold time with one head lost is months; the residual risk is stratification (mixing pump per vessel). Property data must be verified against a He-3 EOS before adoption.

shared_doctrine.verdict: C1.1 shared doctrine leaves the defense only 44 MJ of 209 MJ while the drive runs; with the q^3 + fixed-loss pump model the reserve can exceed the buffer: not acceptable as the only bridge

dedicated.tech: high-power Li-ion / hybrid capacitor pack on the essential services bus (Track R, 150 kJ/kg, 3 kW/kg pack level)
dedicated.location: services bus beside the L2 tie, x -92..-80 (LOW-cooled, cell limit 330 K)
dedicated.verdict: recommended: 2.4 t dedicated shutdown store; the defense buffer keeps its full 209 MJ

c01.flow_vs_power: flow fraction is not the pump-power fraction: hydraulic power falls ~q^3 but EM-pump coil/excitation losses do not, so electrical power at 15 % flow is 0.3-30 % of full power depending on the fixed share; the pump vendor curve decides (OPEN)
c01.open: drive decay heat, HOT loop at part flow and Li freeze margins in the transient: NOT verified (C-01 transient OPEN)

low_growth.verdict: at the joint point the bigger farm raises the cryo rejection: LOW must grow by the one-loop-lost amount (area above) so that one loop lost still carries nominal; the 125 % recovery is then an operating choice, not a design case

rows.case: maximum cryogenic recovery (all heads at the installed 125 %, re-cool after a fault, hours)

low_cases.rule: nominal margin -103 kW; a full-rate re-cool (installed 125 %) uses the whole LOW margin (-412 kW, i.e. at the limit); with one LOW loop lost the re-cool runs at <= 75 % of the operating cooler input or LOW floats to 354 K for the recovery hours (C-14)
low_cases.hot_margin: HOT keeps the 20 % rule and the reactive-peak reserve unchanged (LOW and WARM close without HOT)
low_cases.brow: tabs end at r 37.0: the Brow protection envelope (shadow inside r 37) is unchanged; 8.0 m inside the r 45 Brow rim

psa.note: tab first mode >= 1 Hz (10x the 0.096 Hz global mode, 15x the 0.068 Hz ring spin); lateral tip deflection <= 0.30 m so 1.2 m of the 1.5 m clearance to the ring rim survives; thermal growth nil at 316 K (ammonia panels); two clevis lugs per blade on the PSA radiator root frame

c14.rule: one LOW loop lost: cap the cryocooler input at the operating point (100 %), no 125 % surge; re-cool at the reduced rate (<= 75 % allowed); a 332 K float is NOT allowed (cell limit 330 K)
c14.verdict: vessel hold times are weeks to months, so recovery does not need the 125 % rate; the LOW design margin covers nominal operation, the emergency capacity (one loop lost) covers operation at 100 % cooler input
